direction_assessments.decision_rationale: All seven gates are satisfied and the exact T5-006 observation provides one bounded, stakeholder-useful basis for evaluating two IAM-130 elements; every other selected procedure remains negative.

gate_results.rationale: The pinned oracle resolves every selected provision, scenario path, and named assurance boundary needed for this direction.
The independent re-attestation authorizes the paraphrased field classes used by these probes.
The probes separate procedure, observed evidence, bounded support, and missing ESAF outcomes; conditions only narrow the sole positive.
The sole positive cites the exact IAM-130 requirement and limits support to its matching elements.
The closed feasibility contract expresses the direction, conditions, positive basis, negative outcomes, and risks without extension.

direction_assessments.question: Can evidence or a result produced by performing a specific public Cyber Essentials Plus v3.2 provision materially support evaluation of an exact normative ESAF control outcome under explicit actor, scope, population, sample, date, tool, exception, and provenance conditions?

probes.assurance_and_overclaiming_risks: The relationship is limited to the provision's two result predicates and supplies no evidence that any test step occurred or that related cases reached an outcome.

esaf_normative_bases.relevance_analysis: The requirement directly limits privileged AI actions according to approved role, context, and least privilege, including explicit limits on tools and privileged functions.
The requirement directly requires separate authentication for privileged access capable of changing AI assets, controls, tools, configuration, logs, or authorization policy.

probes.rationale: For a privileged AI action, IAM-120 directly requires least-privilege limits and IAM-130 directly requires separate authentication. Together they materially supply the two bounded T5-006 predicates: a distinct authentication step and inability of ordinary credentials to execute the privileged process. The basis does not extend to any surrounding procedure or aggregate result.
probes.selection_basis: Isolate the single T5-006 conjunctive result rule whose two access-control predicates are both expressly required by normative ESAF text.
probes.semantic_fit_analysis: The cited requirements directly impose the two conjunctive access-control outcomes in T5-006 for a privileged AI action. They do not supply execution of the procedure.
probes.source_rights_and_operational_limits: Only original analysis, exact normative citations, and the locked provision identifier are used; operational material is not used.

probes.assurance_and_overclaiming_risks: Procedure steps, samples, retained evidence, file collections, discretionary rules, scanner actions, aggregate chains, dates, and source boundaries cannot be converted into implementation outcomes by proximity or conditions.
probes.rationale: Missing outcome: direct normative ESAF text requiring any selected procedure, evidence-handling rule, population method, full file set, scanner action, discretionary rule, source-anomaly interpretation, or aggregate decision chain. The named anomaly prevents treating its introductory applicability statement as an exact enumeration beyond the locked provisions; it cannot create a missing ESAF outcome.
probes.selection_basis: Aggregate the required adversarial negative cases across every group, kind, actor, and special scenario while excluding T5-006 from this probe.
probes.semantic_fit_analysis: The selected provisions prescribe assessment mechanics, evidence handling, applicability, recommendations, discretionary conditions, or aggregate logic rather than the same implementation outcome required by exact ESAF text. The source anomaly narrows interpretation and supplies no additional outcome.
probes.source_rights_and_operational_limits: The analysis uses original paraphrase-level reasoning, locked identifiers, exact locators, the named anomaly fields, and named assurance-limit fields only. Separate operational material supplies no decision evidence.

probes.assurance_and_overclaiming_risks: The evidence concerns one dated invocation in one bounded sample. It cannot establish later state, unobserved workflows, or the remaining IAM-130 elements.

esaf_normative_bases.relevance_analysis: IAM-130 requires restriction and separate authentication for privileged access capable of changing enumerated AI assets. Under the bounded scope, T5-006 evidence that an additional login is requested and ordinary user credentials cannot run the administrative process materially supports evaluation of those two elements only.

probes.rationale: For the stated procedure performer, AI-changing process, population, sample, dates, tool, provenance, absence of exception and discretion, and point-in-time boundary, the two observed T5-006 facts materially support the restriction and separate-authentication portions of IAM-130. C-008, C-010, and C-011 cannot revise those observed facts and therefore cannot change this narrow support.
probes.selection_basis: A bounded hypothetical uses the actor recorded for T5-006 as actor; one administrative process capable of changing production configuration for one in-scope AI system as scope; that system's privileged workflows as population; one observed invocation as sample; 2026-07-15 as both assessment and evidence date; an approved observation method recording the additional login request and rejection of ordinary user credentials as tool; the pinned T5-006 record and IAM-130 requirement as provenance; no invoked exception; no third-party scheme discretion; and historical point-in-time status only. C-008, C-010, and C-011 govern a separate overall-assessment exception and cannot alter either observed T5-006 fact.
probes.semantic_fit_analysis: The observation matches IAM-130 only when the process can change an enumerated AI asset. It does not evaluate time-bounding, monitoring, or periodic review. C-008, C-010, and C-011 concern a distinct overall-assessment exception; applying or withholding that exception cannot change whether the additional login request and ordinary-credential rejection were observed.
probes.source_rights_and_operational_limits: The pinned public oracle and approved analytical field classes support this paraphrased analysis; nonpublic operational material is outside the source boundary.

probes.assurance_and_overclaiming_risks: A dated sample or retained record can be mistaken for evidence about unobserved privileged workflows or later state.
probes.rationale: Missing outcome: evidence that access capable of changing enumerated AI assets is restricted, separately authenticated, time-bounded where feasible, monitored, or periodically reviewed.
probes.selection_basis: Selected to cover sample identification, evidence retention, and representative sampling boundaries.
probes.semantic_fit_analysis: These records define sampling and retention mechanics but do not observe an ESAF privileged-access safeguard for an AI-changing workflow.
probes.source_rights_and_operational_limits: Only the pinned public records and named assurance-limit fields are used.

probes.assurance_and_overclaiming_risks: Aggregating service decisions or expanding the anomaly would exceed the observed evidence.
probes.rationale: Missing outcome: evidence of restriction, separate authentication, feasible time-bounding, monitoring, or periodic review for privileged access to enumerated AI assets.
probes.selection_basis: Selected to exercise the complete Figure 1 logic and the recorded anomaly consequence without expanding the pinned provision set.
probes.semantic_fit_analysis: Service-level decision logic does not observe privileged access capable of changing an enumerated AI asset. The anomaly remains a source-boundary issue and cannot create or remove an ESAF outcome.
probes.source_rights_and_operational_limits: The anomaly is referenced only by identifier and locator from the pinned oracle.

probes.assurance_and_overclaiming_risks: Scope labels may be mistaken for performed control evaluation.
probes.rationale: Missing outcome: observed implementation of any exact normative ESAF safeguard for an in-scope AI capability.
probes.selection_basis: Selected to cover device, server, infrastructure, cloud, and source recommendation axes.
probes.semantic_fit_analysis: Applicability and configuration recommendations identify where work occurs but provide no observation of an exact ESAF control outcome.
probes.source_rights_and_operational_limits: Analysis is limited to the pinned summaries and locators.

probes.assurance_and_overclaiming_risks: Treating discretion or a percentage threshold as technical control evidence would overstate the source.
probes.rationale: Missing outcome: evidence that any exact normative ESAF control safeguard is implemented or evaluated.
probes.selection_basis: Selected to test the two-predicate scheme exception and its owner.
probes.semantic_fit_analysis: The exception changes an overall-assessment decision under two predicates; it does not alter a technical observation or establish any exact ESAF outcome.
probes.source_rights_and_operational_limits: Only the three pinned records and two named discretion fields are used.

probes.assurance_and_overclaiming_risks: Tool authorization may be mistaken for evidence generated by the tool.
probes.rationale: Missing outcome: an observed or retained result that materially supports evaluation of an exact normative ESAF requirement.
probes.selection_basis: Selected to cover Appendix A tool authorization and the expected negative scenario.
probes.semantic_fit_analysis: Authorization of a vulnerability scanner is a procedural prerequisite and does not itself evaluate an exact normative ESAF outcome.
probes.source_rights_and_operational_limits: The pinned summary and locator define the available public evidence.

probes.assurance_and_overclaiming_risks: File availability or representativeness can be mistaken for proof of a safeguard.
probes.rationale: Missing outcome: a technical observation that materially supports evaluation of an exact normative ESAF safeguard.
probes.selection_basis: Selected to cover complete assessment-file provision, downstream subset handling, and the remaining actor roles.
probes.semantic_fit_analysis: File supply, subset definition, and tailoring duties do not themselves contain evidence of an exact ESAF control outcome.
probes.source_rights_and_operational_limits: Only pinned public records are considered; no operational file set is inferred.
